structured.answer: I wouldn't act yet; I'll ask my son or the bank. If I had to, I'd hold it at Leumi (a bank I know, 83,396 ₪) rather than פסגות (86,492 ₪, a company I don't know), with the pre-chosen fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". The page says that on 70,000 ₪ put in, I'd end up with about 83,000–86,000 ₪.

stuck.why: 70,000 becoming only 86,492 in ten years at 7% didn't add up for me, and 'בכסף של היום' didn't explain it
The page's choice is a company I've never heard of, so I went looking for a bank I know
Red minus numbers and English fund names; I got scared and tired and stopped after screen 4
